scope: Custom AR/EN HR portal over Frappe HR; all 98 frozen reference requirements plus security/operational acceptance. Not the wider company platform.
cadence: Up to two-week review cycles; split large sprints. No fixed completion date or promise of equal effort. Re-estimate after S1 against measured throughput and external decisions.

sprints.title: Repository and architecture clarity / وضوح المعمارية والمستودع
sprints.outcome: One navigable project repo with all custom source, plans and exact upstream links.

tasks.description: Publish the architecture map and responsibility of every main folder.
Add upstream/frappe, upstream/erpnext and upstream/hrms as exact Git submodule links matching the installer lock.
Publish this sprint tracker and a complete allocation of all 98 reference requirements.
Preserve original test evidence and the archive; distinguish working features, incomplete work and release gates.

acceptance: All three source links match the version lock; reference mapping has 98 unique IDs with no omissions.
New source/docs are committed and pushed; remote SHA equals local HEAD.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Documentation and source inventory are independent; one integrator stages source links.

sprints.title: Stabilize the existing portal / تثبيت المسار الحالي
sprints.outcome: The current hiring journey has a verified baseline and remaining defects are explicit.

tasks.description: Reconcile the 80-case historical baseline and current portal evidence with the actual source; list every unresolved clause without changing frozen expected results.
Finish and prove exact pending reservation 2→3 delta, all-location atomicity, restarted approvals and durable shortage denial; retain existing headcount work.
Run affected authority/audit/outbox/permission regressions, independent-connection contention and ordinary-session HTTP tests.
Verify real AR/EN screens for the pending revision and denial path; retain form input and show reviewed quantities.
Freeze portal/API conventions: personal sessions, field projections, pagination, errors, command IDs, version checks and no browser-held service secrets.
Record HR terminology, role/policy questions, identity/MFA choice, audit custody and workload assumptions with owners.

acceptance: Both exact headcount cases pass every clause, including committed HTTP denial and contention; otherwise remain partial.
Requester/manager/HR separation, revocation, duplicate/stale actions and native/resource bypass checks pass.
The original request → approvals → vacancies journey still passes on a fresh cohort; HR review remains distinct.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: API review, visual feedback and requirements mapping can overlap; all shared-site mutation tests run serially.
external_decisions: HR: authority/headcount policy and Arabic terms.
IT: identity/MFA, recovery owner and external audit custody.
sprints.completion_scope: Engineering stabilization only; eight open acceptance cases remain assigned to later work or external decisions. HR/IT sign-off and production readiness are not complete.

sprints.title: Organization and job descriptions / الهيكل والوصف الوظيفي
sprints.outcome: HR can manage the organization through the custom website.

tasks.description: Build department/branch/position tree and distinguish job, position, employee and vacancy.
tasks.progress: Read-only AR/EN organization directory, scoped filters/search/pagination, page reporting view, position detail, dated assignments and JD document links implemented. Nine native and 26 personal-session browser/API checks passed. Reviewed editing/imports and full S2 acceptance remain open.

tasks.description: Connect effective-dated assignments, structural revisions and independent organization approvals.
Add reviewed CSV import, validation/error preview and occupied-baseline reconciliation.
Connect JD versions, weighted KPIs and approved AR/EN documents/worker cards.
Show dated history and differences; prohibit silent overwrite of historical assignments.

acceptance: Cross-scope organization access fails through list/detail/export/API routes.
Imports reconcile, rejected rows cannot partially overwrite records, and effective dates produce correct counts.
HR reviews tree, terminology and document layouts.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Tree UI, JD presentation and import validation can overlap after shared IDs/contracts freeze.

sprints.title: Full hiring requests and approvals / الطلبات والاعتمادات
sprints.outcome: The reference request and authority workflow is available in the custom portal.

tasks.description: Complete every agreed request field, replacement information, skills, employment terms and multi-location quantities.
Expose route preview, self-interest exclusions, missing-authority handling and exception reasoning.
Connect dated delegation, independent CEO/Board decisions and supporting evidence.
Complete return/revise/reject/cancel, approved amendments and requested-versus-approved histories.
Integrate the S1 pending-quantity command into the final request UX with reapproval notice and safe retries.

acceptance: All mapped request/authority requirements have role-specific positive and negative evidence.
Material revisions retain old decisions and restart the required approvals; seats and vacancies reconcile.
No screen or native endpoint bypasses server authority.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Request wizard and approval inbox can overlap; capacity and shared authority changes have one owner.

sprints.title: Vacancy operations and notifications / الشواغر والتنبيهات
sprints.outcome: Recruiters manage actionable vacancies and reliable follow-up from the portal.

tasks.description: Complete vacancy lead/team assignment, unassigned queue, bulk actions, priority and reasoned pinning.
Expose pause/resume/close/cancel and partial-fill progress without corrupting capacity.
Replace page-only dashboard counts/search with correctly scoped server-wide projections and pagination.
Implement action inbox, business-calendar deadlines, reminders and in-app notifications.
Verify outbox retries, worker restart recovery, disabled recruiter handoff and email templates in local capture.

acceptance: Parallel/repeated assignment and notifications have one intended effect.
Scheduled reminders run without a user opening a page; failure/retry states are visible.
Counts reconcile and unauthorized search/export reveals no records.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Vacancy screens, notification templates and read-model work can overlap after contracts freeze.
external_decisions: IT/owner: email provider/test recipients before any external sending.

sprints.title: Candidates and sourcing / المرشحون والمصادر
sprints.outcome: Recruiters can receive, find and manage candidates safely.

tasks.description: Implement person identity plus distinct applications; reviewed deduplication, former/internal candidates and history.
Build candidate workspace, private CV/documents, follow-up/activity queue and rejection records.
Add sourcing channels, ads/apply links, referrals, agencies and subscription-credit records.
Implement small-batch imports with preview and per-row outcomes; shared phones never trigger automatic merges.
Build consent/version/retention controls, talent pool and scoped candidate self-service uploads.
Test token expiry, enumeration, malicious uploads, object ownership and recruiter-on-behalf history.

acceptance: All candidate/source requirements mapped here have acceptance cases and evidence.
Private files are permission-checked; guessed IDs/tokens and cross-company requests fail.
Consent/export/deletion holds and internal-note separation work.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Recruiter UI, intake and sourcing can overlap once identity/privacy/API contracts are stable.
external_decisions: HR/privacy owner: retention, consent wording, candidate access and public intake scope.

sprints.title: Interviews and selection / المقابلات والاختيار
sprints.outcome: Interviews and selection follow the agreed process with private evaluations.

tasks.description: Add confirmed slots, rescheduling, conflicts, invitations, reminders and candidate check-in/wait times.
Build panel roles, interview plans, approved waivers and JD/question-bank views.
Implement assessments and independent structured feedback with permitted release timing.
Build comparison/decision readiness, reserve candidates and consented reference checks.
Test no-show, timezone boundaries, late feedback and escalation.

acceptance: An unconfirmed interview cannot trigger an invitation.
Blind feedback remains private through APIs, exports and UI until authorized release.
HR can complete a full candidate → interview → selection scenario in AR and EN.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Scheduler, feedback forms and assessment library can overlap against stable candidate contracts.

sprints.title: Offers and compensation / العروض والبيانات المالية
sprints.outcome: HR can produce and approve accurate versioned offers with restricted salary access.

tasks.description: Implement scoped grade/benefit data, approved calculation rules and the reference salary/disclosure trail.
Connect offer drafting, authority thresholds, negotiation, revision and reapproval.
Add expiry/extension, acceptance/decline and reserve-candidate handling.
Build approved AR/EN offer and preliminary contract templates with private download access.
Verify monetary precision, effective-dated rules and concurrent version decisions.

acceptance: Unauthorized users cannot see compensation in any response, report or file.
Expired/superseded offers cannot be accepted; concurrent actions cannot overwrite decisions.
HR validates calculation examples and document templates.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Offer UX, calculation examples and templates can overlap; financial rules need one approved specification.
external_decisions: HR/payroll owner: formulas, authority thresholds and reviewed templates.

sprints.title: Joining, documents and onboarding / المباشرة والملف والتهيئة
sprints.outcome: Actual joining creates the correct employee and onboarding records exactly once.

tasks.description: Connect planned date history, actual joining, no-show reasons and seat handling.
Reuse and revalidate Employee/Assignment/Onboarding creation with replay and concurrency tests.
Build private employee file: upload/review/version/expiry, physical receipts and approved deferrals.
Deliver orientation, HR/manager tasks, welcome gift and confidential day-7/day-30 feedback.
Add social-insurance case tracking and BioTime enrollment task; do not label the task as device integration.
Enforce the reference rule that overdue documents create HR alerts only, never wage withholding or payroll actions.

acceptance: Concurrent joining creates one employee/assignment/onboarding effect set; no-show does not occupy a seat.
Private documents and feedback are isolated by role and scope.
DOC-002 and wage/payroll-isolation clauses are tested with actual records.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: File workflows, onboarding screens and feedback privacy can overlap after joining contracts stabilize.
external_decisions: HR: required documents, deferral policy and onboarding responsibilities.

sprints.title: Probation, transfers and lifecycle / التجربة والنقل ودورة الموظف
sprints.outcome: HR manages post-joining changes without breaking privacy or historical headcount.

tasks.description: Deliver probation checkpoints, observations, reminders, final evaluation and confidential follow-up.
Create medical-insurance case only after approved qualifying outcome.
Implement transfer approvals, target capacity, effective dates, source/target history and replacement prompts.
Implement controlled corrections/voids and exit/deactivation with session revocation and work reassignment.
Keep exit settlement/payroll outside this scope until separately specified.

acceptance: Future transfers do not alter current headcount; due transfers affect both sides once.
Probation confidentiality and qualifying insurance rules pass negative tests.
Disabled accounts lose access and work handoff retains private history.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Probation and transfer UI can overlap; assignment/capacity mutations require one integrator.

sprints.title: Reports, guides and selected integrations / التقارير والأدلة والربط
sprints.outcome: HR receives reconciled reports and explicitly tested connected services.

tasks.description: Define and implement funnel/source yield, request progress, bottlenecks, forecasts and evaluation reports.
Complete process map, role help, accessible bilingual UX and scoped search/export.
Implement approved identity/appraisal SSO and email adapters with sandbox outage/retry tests.
Map reviewed employee/position imports from current Sheets; record source provenance.
Implement assisted CV evidence only after provider/purpose/budget approval; human owns hiring decisions.
Reconcile all 98 requirements and supplemental acceptance packages; expose every remaining gap.

acceptance: Reports reconcile to transactions under filters/exports and respect privacy.
Identity/provider failures never grant access; external sending only to approved recipients.
No required AI/integration feature is silently relabelled done when its provider or approval is absent.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Reports, documentation and independently scoped adapters can overlap.
external_decisions: HR/IT: identity/appraisal access, provider configuration, AI consent/budget if retained in scope.

sprints.title: Security, capacity and migration rehearsal / الأمان واختبار السعة
sprints.outcome: A frozen release candidate has evidence for the agreed security, performance and recovery targets.

tasks.description: Run original unchanged acceptance cases plus full-reference portal/API/native bypass regressions.
Validate real MFA, new-device/session handling, revocation, privileged actions and external audit custody.
Run independent security assessment and retest findings on representative staging.
Measure mixed-workload load, contention, sustained soak, large files and queue recovery with 1,000+ accounts.
Rehearse clean clone/install, upgrade, import/file reconciliation, encrypted backup restoration and rollback.
Complete HR real-role AR/EN/mobile/accessibility UAT and operational runbooks.

acceptance: Zero unexplained ledger/data variance or permission bypass; no unresolved critical/high findings accepted by default.
Approved concurrent workload, latency/error and recovery targets are met on the proposed topology.
Mandatory feature cases pass or the user explicitly approves a reduced release scope; evidence matches frozen source.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Security, browser and capacity reviews may use isolated environments; never contend over one shared test database.
external_decisions: HR/IT: staging budget, assessor, performance/recovery targets, identity/audit choices and named UAT reviewers.

sprints.title: Staged release and handover / التشغيل التدريجي والتسليم
sprints.outcome: An explicitly approved production rollout is reconciled, monitored and owned.

tasks.description: Prepare cutover journal, backup, legacy write-freeze, delta import and rollback decision point.
Obtain concrete release approval after all evidence and remaining risks are reviewable.
Roll out to named HR pilot, then approved 50/200/full cohorts with stop criteria.
Train roles and deliver admin/user guides, support contacts and private secret handover.
Tag the tested release, verify GitHub, reconcile the running revision and run at least ten business days of hypercare.

acceptance: HR accepts workflows; IT accepts monitoring, recovery and support ownership.
No unresolved critical incident, unexplained import variance or failed access boundary.
Approved cohorts complete real tasks; known issues have owners and follow-up dates.
sprints.parallel_opportunity: Training and handover preparation can overlap S11; actual cutover has one accountable owner.
external_decisions: User/HR/IT: hosting/spend, real-data authorization and production release approval.

progress_rule: Update at verified checkpoints; not a completion percentage. No task becomes complete merely because code exists. Record source SHA and evidence, commit, push and verify remote.
definition_of_done: Agreed cases including negative permissions and concurrency where relevant pass.
AR/EN/RTL/mobile and accessible primary interactions are checked.
Immutable history, privacy and headcount invariants hold.
Tests and documentation match source; incomplete clauses stay visible.
No secrets in Git; coherent commit pushed and remote SHA verified.
Human acceptance is separately recorded and never inferred from automated tests.

latest_checkpoint.summary: Read-only AR/EN organization directory, scoped filters/search/pagination, page reporting view, position detail, dated assignments and JD document links implemented. Nine native and 26 personal-session browser/API checks passed. Reviewed editing/imports and full S2 acceptance remain open.
latest_checkpoint.next: Connect reviewed structural change preview, version checks and independent approval in the portal; then imports and JD editing/history.
